name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: A file chip / thumbnail card for chat and message-compose surfaces - media slot, name + meta, uploading/error/complete states, remove/download actions.

meta.whenToUse: A file attached to a chat message or a message-compose input - a chip/thumbnail with name, size, upload progress, and a remove action.
meta.whenNotToUse: A generic file upload/drop zone with no chat context - reach for Empty (bordered drop zone) or a form Field instead.
